data.title: Eastern Region Municipality Launches Urban Initiative in Dammam with Participation of 1,000 Students
data.content:
Dammam, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Eastern Region Municipality, in collaboration with a local bank and in coordination with the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing, has launched the an urban initiative in Dammam under a volunteer program, engaging 1,000 students to raise environmental awareness and enhance the urban landscape.
    Municipality spokesperson Faisal Al-Zahrani noted that the public-private initiative empowers youth to practice environmental stewardship and forms part of a national campaign targeting over 10,000 students across 17 municipalities in afforestation, removing visual distortion, waste disposal, beach cleanups, and school painting, in line with Saudi Vision 2030 quality-of-life goals.
    -- SPA
12:39 Local Time 09:39 GMT
